UserReaderSettings.title: UserReaderSettings
UserReaderSettings.description: Stores a signed-in user's FlipStream news reader preferences, eye-care theme, auto-refresh interval, enabled categories, and saved article IDs.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owner

bio.description: Short reader bio and topic interests

refreshIntervalMinutes.description: Automatic RSS refresh interval in minutes (0 for manual, or 1, 5, 15, 30)

bookmarkedIds.description: Bounded list of saved article IDs (max 50)

enabledCategories.description: Bounded list of enabled news category IDs (max 12)

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of last profile sync

/users/{userId}.description: Owner-only document storing reader settings, auto-refresh interval, enabled categories, and saved bookmarks.
